subject: Fraud & Scams
title: Before Ponzi: The Original Swindlers
description: One-minute skill: Before Ponzi: The Original Swindlers.

hook.text: Ponzi didn't invent the scheme. Sarah Howe ran the same con in Boston — forty years earlier.

buildup.text: In 1880, Howe promised 8% monthly returns to women through her 'Ladies' Deposit Company.'

discovery.text: She paid early depositors with money from later ones, just like Ponzi would decades later.

twist.text: William Miller ran another version in 1899, promising 10% weekly. He called himself '520 Percent Miller.'

climax.text: Ponzi got the fame, but the trick had been perfected by others long before him.

quiz.question: Who ran a Ponzi-like scheme decades before Ponzi?
